components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; background: #2f5f7a; padding: 0 1rem; } .ds-tabs a { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.75rem; color: #c6d9e3; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tabs a:hover { color: #f4f8fa; } .ds-tabs a.active { color: #f4f8fa; border-bottom-color: #f4f8fa; } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #78b6e0; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Status Symbols
components.description: Chart symbol plus plain text: disc done, half disc in progress, diamond review, triangle waiting, ring to do, dashed square on hold.
components.html: DoneIn progressReviewWaitingTo doOn hold
components.css: .ds-st { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; color: #1f3340; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-st::before { content: ''; width: 0.72rem; height: 0.72rem; flex: none; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-done::before { background: #2f6e57; } .ds-progress::before { border: 1.5px solid #c88a1b; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #c88a1b 50%, transparent 50%); } .ds-review::before { background: #3a73a3; border-radius: 1px; transform: rotate(45deg) scale(0.82); } .ds-waiting::before { background: #6b5a8e; border-radius: 0; clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-todo::before { border: 1.5px solid #7d8e98; } .ds-hold { color: #3f5561; font-weight: 400; } .ds-hold::before { border: 1.5px dashed #7d8e98; border-radius: 1px; }

components.css: .ds-board { background: #fbfcfc; border: 1px solid #ccd7dd; border-top: 2px solid #3b5565; border-radius: 0 0 3px 3px; padding: 1rem 1.5rem 1.5rem; color: #1f3340; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-title { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-size: 1.1875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-table { width: 100%; table-layout: fixed; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-table th { text-align: left; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; color: #3f5561; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #3b5565; } .ds-table td { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #ccd7dd; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table tr:hover > td { background: #e8eff2; } .ds-table tr.ds-overdue > td { background: #f8e5ed; } .ds-late { color: #ad1259; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Gantt Chart Border
components.description: Three-segment graticule axis, hairline bearing line for today, solid and dashed-outline bars.

components.css: .ds-gantt { width: 280px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #3f5561; } .ds-axis { position: relative; height: 1.1em; padding-bottom: 11px; box-sizing: content-box; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-axis::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 6px; border: 1px solid #3b5565; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b5565 33.333%, #fbfcfc 33.333% 66.666%, #3b5565 66.666%); } .ds-s { position: absolute; left: 0; } .ds-e { position: absolute; right: 0; } .ds-track { position: relative; height: 14px; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; background-color: #eff3f5; background-image: linear-gradient(#ccd7dd, #ccd7dd), linear-gradient(#ccd7dd, #ccd7dd); background-size: 1px 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: 33.333% 0, 66.666% 0; } .ds-today { position: absolute; top: -2px; bottom: -2px; width: 1px; background: #1f3340; z-index: 1; } .ds-bar { position: absolute; top: 2px; height: 10px; border-radius: 1px; min-width: 6px; } .ds-done-bar { background: #2f6e57; } .ds-late-bar { background: #ad1259; } .ds-open { background: transparent; border: 1px dashed #586f7c; box-sizing: border-box; }

narrative.overview: A weekly review is a passage plan, not a dashboard: every row is a position to check against hazards and dates. A deep chart-navy band carries brand and navigation. The working ground is a pale sea tint, with near-white sheets laid on it, hairline ink rules, and 2-3px corners. There are no shadows and no big-number tiles. Ink is blue-black. Numerals are tabular and small. The page lets one colour mean one thing: magenta is reserved for work that is overdue or needs attention now. Everything else is quiet: chart blue for structure and anything clickable, amber for work under way, sea green for done.
keyCharacteristics: Chart-blue shell band, pale sea ground, near-white sheets with a 2px dark top rule.
One loud colour, one meaning (magenta = overdue / needs attention now).
Status is a small CSS-drawn chart symbol plus plain text, never a coloured block.
Fixed column grid: the same column has the same width in every table.
Flat: depth comes from tone, hairlines and the dark top rule, never from shadow.
Gantt drawn as chart furniture: graticule scale, bearing line, dashed open-ended work.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Magenta means overdue or needs attention now, and nothing else. Never use it for brand, decoration, emphasis, categories or "important" in general.

rules.name: The Symbol-Not-Block Rule
rules.body: Status colours appear only inside the small status symbol or a gantt bar; they never fill a cell, chip or card.

rules.name: The Quiet Majority Rule
rules.body: If every row in a group is flagged, the tint says nothing. Such tables get all-flagged and drop the row tint; the date stays magenta and bold.

rules.name: The Atomic Value Rule
rules.body: Dates, keys, statuses and names are white-space: nowrap and never break mid-value. Only the item column wraps.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate things with a hairline or a tonal step, not a shadow.

dos: Do use magenta (hazard-magenta) only for overdue or needs-attention-now.
Do use chart blue for links, keys and structure; amber for work under way; sea green for done.
Do show status as the CSS-drawn symbol plus plain text.
Do give new tables a <colgroup> and table-layout: fixed, reusing existing column widths.
Do add all-flagged when every row in a group would be overdue or scheduled.
Do keep row-overdue / row-scheduled classes on rows; tests assert them.
Do add data-label to date cells so they read in the stacked mobile card.
Do route new colours through custom properties in base.html.
Do keep icons on the icon macro: 20-unit grid, 1.6 stroke.
donts: Don't use magenta for brand, decoration or generic emphasis.
Don't fill a cell, chip or card with a status colour.
Don't add shadows, big-number metric tiles or saturated colour-block cards.
Don't add web fonts or image/icon files; there is no static mount, so type is the system stack and icons are inline SVG.
Don't let dates, keys, statuses or names wrap mid-value.
Don't draw open-ended work as a filled bar.
Don't put person names, emails, company domains or Jira site URLs into any committed file.
